subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a public skill configuration action contract, and if so should the canonical source be SKILL.md frontmatter, ClawHub/Skill Card metadata, or a plugin manifest action?
rationale: The code path is straightforward, but the decision controls a public skill metadata/API surface and a dashboard URL trust boundary that automation should not invent.

options.title: Design a typed safe action contract
options.body: Add a constrained configuration action field with URL validation, opener rules, docs, and UI tests before allowing dashboard buttons.

options.title: Use existing homepage/Skill Card only
options.body: Decline new fields and document that skills should use `homepage`, Skill Cards, or ClawHub pages for configuration discovery.

options.title: Move the contract to ClawHub/plugin metadata
options.body: Keep SKILL.md lean and require package-distribution metadata to advertise configuration entry points.

recommendation.title: Design a typed safe action contract
recommendation.body: Add a constrained configuration action field with URL validation, opener rules, docs, and UI tests before allowing dashboard buttons.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history points to steipete on both the skill metadata/status and dashboard skill surfaces, and the decision spans product/security boundaries.
